## Summary
The signalling package defines participant signaling contracts and concrete helpers for handling client signal requests, writing asynchronous signal responses, and constructing LiveKit SignalResponse protobuf messages. It also provides no-op implementations used as embedded defaults or unsupported adapters.

## Responsibilities
- Define participant signal handler, signaller, and outbound signaling interfaces.
- Dispatch inbound SignalRequest messages to local participant operations.
- Manage asynchronous response sinks and close or swap signal connections.
- Build typed SignalResponse protobuf messages for room, participant, track, subscription, data track, and reconnection events.
- Provide no-op signal handler, signaller, and signaling implementations.
- Define sentinel signaling validation and permission errors.
